human_scope_review: Owner reported on 5 Nov 2026 that after signing out of the same local phone account, entering the original phone and password yields a false incorrect-credentials message. Approved urgent bug fix scope: never clear or overwrite the verified identity or financial data, check OS-protected verifier ownership before phone sign-out, verify durable read-back at registration, and distinguish missing/malformed credential state from password rejection. No password reset bypass, new provider, DB migration, key rotation, or relaxed login allowed. Existing lockout requires exact device diagnosis and a signed APK test.
user_requested_changes: Prevent sign-out from removing a phone session when its original OS-protected login verifier cannot be found or belongs to another identity; preserve all finance and registration data.
After first-time phone registration, verify secure credential read-back against the exact original phone/password before committing a profile; fail closed if not durable.
Do not display incorrect password for a missing/malformed secure verifier. Keep wrong phone/password locked and never recreate credentials from a failed login.
Test correct same-phone/password verification across sign-out contract plus wrong-password, different-phone, corrupt verifier, and source privacy guarantees.
